title: Completion of coherent modules on a proper scheme over a complete Noetherian ring is fully faithful
statement: Let $A$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] complete with respect to an ideal $I$ [def-weil-pbc-adically-complete-ring], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism] and $\mathcal I=I\mathcal O_X$. Then the completion functor $\mathit{Coh}(\mathcal O_X)\to\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)$, $\mathcal F\mapsto\mathcal F^\wedge$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], is fully faithful: for coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [pqf-def-coherent] $\mathcal F,\mathcal G$ the map $u\mapsto u^\wedge$, $\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O_X}(\mathcal G,\mathcal F)\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathit{Coh}(X,\mathcal I)}(\mathcal G^\wedge,\mathcal F^\wedge)$, is bijective.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 0883 (lemma-fully-faithful); its proof uses Lemma 0882 (lemma-completion-internal-hom) and the theorem on formal functions in the form of Lemma 087U (lemma-spell-out-theorem-formal-functions; Theorem 02OC theorem-formal-functions, Section 02O7 section-theorem-formal-functions)
